P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait appears anywhere on the page; the dominant visual is a large typographic block, not a human anchor.

P05.rationale: There is no client portrait present; the case study column shows only a text-based quote block with no named person image.

P07.rationale: No press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present beyond a single inline pull-quote.

P10.rationale: The oversized 'von 30 auf 2 Minuten' typographic block functions as a giant decorative numeral/ghost-text element dominating the centre of the page.

P11.rationale: The large stat block shows before/after numbers (30→2 min, 1hr→5 min) but they are purely typographic with no chart, graph, or cost-math visualisation.

P12.rationale: The page is reasonably well-filled with a large stat panel, quote block, and body-copy sections, though the lower half feels text-heavy without visual variety.

P13.rationale: A subtle paper/cream texture is applied to the background, providing mild atmosphere rather than flat white, though it is very understated.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photograph is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page is almost entirely typographic with no photography, so generic stock imagery is not an issue, though the absence of specific visuals keeps it somewhat generic.

N08.rationale: The left column below the quote block has noticeable empty space, but the overall layout is reasonably filled and the dead area is not egregious.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photograph; all text sits on solid or lightly textured backgrounds with good legibility.
